# T9 evals — no dead-end routes

All e2e checks live in `e2e/t9-routes.spec.ts`, first line `test.use({ channel: "chrome" });`. Run: `npx playwright test e2e/t9-routes.spec.ts` (mock server port 3201). /status out of scope.

E1. covers redirect file exists — cmd: `test -f "src/app/(app)/covers/page.tsx" && grep -q 'redirect("/policies")' "src/app/(app)/covers/page.tsx"` — PASS if exit 0.

E2. GET /covers lands on /policies — test `covers redirects to policies`: `await page.goto("/covers"); await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/policies$/);` — PASS if URL ends `/policies` and the final response status is 200 (`expect(resp.status()).toBe(200)`).

E3. /contact frame — test `contact in public frame`: goto `/contact`; assert `page.locator("header a[href='/']").first()` visible, `page.getByRole("link", { name: "Back", exact: true })` has `href` "/", `page.locator("footer")` visible and count 1 — PASS if all hold.

E4. /privacy frame — same assertions as E3 on `/privacy` (test `privacy in public frame`) — PASS if all hold.

E5. /terms frame — same assertions as E3 on `/terms` (test `terms in public frame`) — PASS if all hold.

E6. Legal Back link navigates — test `back link goes home`: for each of /contact, /privacy, /terms click link named "Back"; `await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/$/)` — PASS if all three land on `/`.

E7. /welcome heading and exact links — test `welcome has three steps`: goto `/welcome`; `getByRole("heading", { name: /^You're in, .+\.$/ })` visible (non-empty name); links named "1. Add your policy" href `/covers/add`, "2. Add your family" href `/family`, "3. See what you'd pay" href `/stress-test`; `page.getByRole("main").getByRole("link")` count is exactly 3 and `page.getByRole("main").getByRole("button")` count is 0 — PASS if all hold.

E8. all routes respond fast — test `routes 200 under 3s`: for `/covers`, `/contact`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/welcome`, `/policies`, time `page.goto`; assert final status 200 and elapsed < 3000 ms — PASS if all six hold.

E9. design tokens untouched — cmd: `git diff origin/main -- $(git ls-files '*tokens.css') | wc -l | tr -d ' '` (must find at least one tokens.css: `git ls-files '*tokens.css' | grep -q .`) — PASS if exit 0 and output `0`.

E10. verify — cmd: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — PASS if exit 0.
